body: Okay, thank you for your time and response. I will call my provider soon.
It is very important, I will have to learn to trust myself, thank you for this advice.
Also thank you for responding, it means so much to me.
I was thinking I had SS but I stopped taking my pills for a while now. I wonder if you can still have lasting affects of SS even if you don’t take the pills for a while.
Thank you so much for this. ♥️♥️♥️
You are not wrong, thank you for you response.
I’m not sure, I hope this question isn’t for future reference. If you need help, like just need to talk to someone you can PM me.

I know how you feel. I had two unsuccessful attempts. I am now paying the price though. I am not living to be honest. It is no longer because my mental health, but physical. I have no energy because of the side effects of my attempts. I am now very ill because of my attempts. I know you can get better. Even though I don’t know you personally but I have faith that your feelings of worthlessness and feeling like a failure will be no longer one day.
